cases.description: builds a CALL_FUNCTION request from company_info_source's own sql_name (a parameterless SQLQueries lookup, unlike qr_source -- OADM has exactly one row, no key needed), clears active_node_id (not tied to any registered process), and sets suppress_delivery so a failed lookup never reaches the user or aborts document generation -- Merge Company Info Result already falls back to the organization's own company_info on failure
